definition: A customer or organization that commissions work or production and reviews the requirements and deliverables.
example: Please gather the client feedback into a single document.

definition: A way of doing work with the company's internal staff or team rather than outsourcing to an external vendor.
example: We make the first draft in-house and only outsource the shoot.

definition: Entrusting part or all of the work to external personnel or vendors.
example: Let's first define the outsourcing scope and number of revisions.

definition: An external company that carries out certain work or business together.
example: Please share the delivery schedule with the partner company.

definition: The central organization or office where a company's main management and administrative functions are gathered.
example: Headquarters distributed a common guide.

definition: An organization or office that carries out company work in a region apart from headquarters.
example: Check the regional schedule with the branch office contact.

definition: An organization in charge of a defined business unit such as a product, service, or market.
example: Please check which business division is in charge of this project.

definition: An organizational unit that groups several departments or teams to lead a specific function or business.
example: Let's align next quarter's priorities at the division level.

definition: An organizational unit that works together on a shared goal or task.
example: Please invite the relevant team's contact to the meeting.

definition: A temporary organization that gathers several people to solve a specific problem or project.
example: We formed a task force for the new service launch.

definition: An organization in charge of support work such as HR, general affairs, and finance needed to run the company.
example: Check the supply purchasing process with the management support team.

definition: An organization responsible for member-related systems and operations such as hiring, evaluation, compensation, and training.
example: Align the new colleague's onboarding schedule with the HR team.

definition: An organization in charge of the company's common operations such as facilities, supplies, assets, and the office environment.
example: Please pass the meeting room equipment issue to the general affairs team.

definition: An organization in charge of the company's financial management such as funding plans, procurement, and execution.
example: Check the project's cash spending plan with the finance team.

definition: An organization that records transactions and manages accounting information such as costs, revenue, and closing.
example: Please pass the supporting documents to the accounting team.

definition: An organization that reviews and supports the company's legal matters such as contracts and disputes.
example: Check the usage-scope wording in the contract with the legal team.

definition: An organization that reviews suppliers, prices, and terms for needed goods and services and carries out purchasing.
example: Compare quotes with the purchasing team before ordering equipment.

definition: An organization that finds customers and drives proposals, contracts, and revenue.
example: Let's share the customer requirements the sales team received.

definition: An organization in charge of understanding customers and the market and building awareness of and demand for the brand and products.
example: Please align the launch messaging with the marketing team.

definition: An organization that receives and helps resolve customer inquiries, complaints, and usage problems.
example: The CS team compiled the recurring inquiries and passed them on.
note: CS here refers to customer support. Distinguish it from other meanings of the same abbreviation, such as computer science.

definition: An organization that manages work processes and issues so a service or business runs smoothly every day.
example: We decide how to handle post-launch inquiries with the operations team.

definition: The top executive responsible for overall company management and leading major decisions.
example: We report business progress to the CEO.

definition: The top executive overseeing the company's financial strategy and the management of funds and finances.
example: We review the financial impact of the investment plan with the CFO.

definition: The top executive overseeing the company's main operating systems and execution.
example: We share operational process improvements with the COO.

definition: The top executive leading the company's overall marketing strategy and organization.
example: The CMO shared this year's brand strategy.

definition: A position that leads a team's goals and the assignment and progress of its work.
example: Align priorities with the team lead for schedule changes.

definition: A position responsible for a division-level unit in a company or production organization. Team size and authority vary by organization.
example: Deliver the final draft after the office head's review.

definition: A position that leads the goals and operations of a division made up of several teams and departments.
example: Report items needing cross-department coordination to the division head.

definition: A person or position that leads a specific work part within a team.
example: Decide this week's task allocation with the part lead.

definition: The person responsible for carrying out and responding to a specific task.
example: Please write one person in charge next to each item.

definition: An HR-level tier a company uses to distinguish career level and role.
example: Check the job grade and the actual project role separately.
note: Grade names and promotion systems differ by company and do not necessarily match job title.

definition: A spot in an organization that carries responsibility and authority.
example: Please check the approval scope of the team lead position.
note: How companies distinguish grade, rank, and position can differ.

definition: A term for a practitioner whose experience and scope of independent work in the area is relatively early-stage.
example: Please split out a scope that's good for a junior to take.

definition: A skilled practitioner who, based on their experience, leads complex work and supports other members.
example: Review the approach to difficult tasks with a senior.

definition: A person who takes on work independently on a project or contract basis.
example: We're collaborating with a freelance designer on this work.

definition: The work of setting goals and targets and designing what to do, how, and on what schedule.
example: In the planning stage, first clarify the problem to solve.

definition: A document organized to propose goals, content, approach, schedule, and so on.
example: Please include the target customers and expected effects in the proposal.

definition: The functions, conditions, and constraints a deliverable or service must satisfy.
example: Separate required and optional items in the requirements.

definition: A document organizing the scope, quantity, amount, and terms of the work or items to be provided.
example: Please also state the basis for additional-work costs in the quotation.

definition: Officially requesting the supply of goods or work under set conditions.
example: We place the order after confirming the final specs.

definition: Checking whether a delivery or work result meets the agreed conditions and quality.
example: Please gather the inspection feedback in one pass with nothing missing.

definition: Handing over agreed goods or deliverables to the specified recipient.
example: Deliver the originals and final files separately.

definition: Work that matches actual amounts spent with transaction records to finalize amounts paid or received.
example: After the event ends, gather the receipts and settle.

definition: A process of having work or spending reviewed and approved by an authorized person.
example: Please attach the quote and submit the spending for approval.
note: 결재 (approval, a sign-off process) and 결제 (payment) are different words.

definition: Paying for goods or services.
example: After the approval is signed off, pay the vendor.
note: 결제 (payment) and 결재 (approval) are different words.

definition: The process of helping new members, customers, or users get familiar with how an organization or product works.

definition: Passing a task's progress, materials, methods, and cautions to the next person in charge.
example: Mark the incomplete items in the handover document.

definition: Reporting material organized for its purpose, such as progress, analysis results, or performance.

definition: The amount of human work needed for a task, expressed in terms of people and time.

definition: A relationship where another task or condition must be completed first before proceeding.

definition: An uncertain factor that could negatively affect goals, schedule, cost, or quality.

definition: Checking again on the status of progress or whether something was applied.

definition: After setting the big direction, concretely refining the small elements and the finish.

definition: Returning work or a system to a previous state when a problem occurs or a decision changes.

definition: Keeping a separate copy in preparation for data loss.
example: Please make a backup before editing the original.

definition: The state of a deliverable or software distinguished by edits and changes.

definition: Doing already-done work again due to errors, changes, or failing to meet the criteria.
example: Align the requirements first to reduce rework.

definition: Looking over a result or plan to identify problems and improvements.

definition: Choosing and bringing or taking on what's needed from various materials or candidates. Also used to mean receiving an item.

definition: What a customer or work counterpart needs or wants to solve.
